sampling.rule: Stratify by kind. Exclude names appearing in previous case targets OR any returned candidate in the exclusion files. For each remaining module ID compute SHA256(seed + literal backslash-zero + kind + literal backslash-zero + id), sort ascending hexadecimal digest, take first four per kind without replacement. SHA256 seeded pseudorandom ordering approximates uniform sampling; no relevance/manual replacement filter.
sampling.samplingUnit: catalog module ID, so Skill package versions are distinct units; this is not uniform over independent capabilities
sampling.handlingInsufficientDescription: Retain sampled module and flag missing information; do not replace it to make queries easier. Service descriptors may support only coarse discovery requests, never invented tool arguments.

cases.en: Our salespeople jump to demos before understanding buyers. Coach them on a 30-minute customer interview that uncovers the current process, business impact and real motivation to change.
cases.zh: 销售总是还没听懂客户就开始演示产品。请指导一场30分钟客户访谈，问清现有流程、问题的业务影响和真正的改变动机。

evidence.basis: Original role specifies SPIN, gap analysis, current/future state mapping and a 30-minute discovery call structure.

dependencies: Original role prose and user-supplied sales context
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Can discuss or role-play with supplied fictional context; no claim of improved sales conversion or permission to contact buyers. Actual model token cost is outside module metadata.

cases.en: Using the supplied buyer and target financials, prepare an acquisition model showing earnings-per-share accretion or dilution and sensitivity to purchase price and synergies; clearly separate assumptions from supplied facts.
cases.zh: 根据我提供的收购方和标的财务数据，搭建并购模型，分析每股收益增厚或摊薄，以及收购价格和协同效应变化的敏感性，明确区分假设和已知数据。

evidence.basis: Role has merger model accretion/dilution, synergy analysis, scenario sensitivity and model audit within its intact 22-Skill toolbox.

dependencies: Original enclosed merger-model and scenario-sensitivity Skills
Spreadsheet/runtime tools if a workbook is requested
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Synthetic supplied financial data can be used without market APIs; do not fetch paid financial databases, execute deals or treat output as investment advice. Model correctness still needs independent numeric checks.

cases.en: A Tencent Omics workflow run has failed. Retrieve the logs for the run ID I provide, distinguish out-of-memory from disk or scheduling errors, and produce a structured diagnosis with repair suggestions without resubmitting the job.
cases.zh: 腾讯组学工作流运行失败了。请根据我提供的运行ID读取日志，区分内存不足、磁盘和调度问题，输出结构化诊断与修复建议，不要重新提交任务。

evidence.basis: Role requires omics-run-diagnosis, platform log retrieval and 11 error categories; explicitly forbids proactive submission/resubmission.

dependencies: User-supplied RunGroupId or RunId and authorized Tencent Omics access
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Live log access requires a real authorized platform account and possibly private network; cost is unverified. No login, token retrieval, paid API or job submission is authorized by this retrieval-only case. Offline logs could test diagnostic reasoning separately.

cases.en: For the 2025 Fujian physics-track entrance exam, look up the provincial rank corresponding to 600 points, preserve the returned year and source, and do not silently substitute another year's data or predict admission chances.
cases.zh: 查询2025年福建物理类高考600分对应的全省位次，保留返回数据的年份与来源，不要悄悄换成年份不同的数据，也不要预测录取概率。

evidence.basis: Original role separates pure score-to-rank lookup from application planning, enforces data-year provenance and refuses to invent missing results.

dependencies: Other role paths may require connect_cloud_service and quota
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: No actual score API or cloud credential call made. Availability, authorization and free quota are not verified; missing target-year data must remain a stated gap, not estimated.

cases.en: A WeData scheduled job is much slower than its previous run. Break down scheduling wait, engine submission and application time, compare the previous cycle, and identify resource-queue bottlenecks while retaining the diagnostic evidence.
cases.zh: WeData调度任务这次比上一周期慢很多。请拆分调度等待、引擎提交和应用运行耗时，对比上一周期，定位资源队列瓶颈，并保留诊断证据。

evidence.basis: Entry explicitly decomposes scheduling/engine/application delays, collects previous-cycle logs and scans materialized log caches; preserving evidence prevents its default cleanup.

dependencies: US/WeData credentials, project/task/date context and internal network
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Not portable generic job diagnosis; depends on Tencent internal platform. Do not call write commands or run default cache deletion. Cost/free access unknown; no live platform calls in this case.

cases.en: In our JackYun ERP, look up the current stock of the item code I provide across warehouses. Return stock quantities by warehouse rather than treating shipment or transfer documents as current inventory; make no business changes.
cases.zh: 在吉客云ERP里查询我提供的货品编码在各仓库的即时库存，按仓库列出数量，不要把发货或调拨单据当成当前库存，也不要修改业务数据。

evidence.basis: Read-only ERP routing maps current stock to erp.stockquantity.get and distinguishes documents from inventory.

dependencies: User-supplied item code and warehouse scope
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Tool subscription and account authorization required; price unknown. No credential or live business query performed. Company name is retained because the target data system matters, not to inject the module slug.

cases.en: Find Chinese cultural associations in Lyon that could be relevant to an exhibition. Distinguish officially registered associations from verified reachable contacts, include their pages, and do not claim a postal address means someone can be contacted.
cases.zh: 寻找里昂适合文化展览合作的华人协会，区分官方登记记录与已认证、可联系的真人，附协会页面，不要因为有登记地址就声称能联系上。

evidence.basis: RNA-based association search routes culture/friendship kinds, uses has_contact and certified fields, and requires stable page URLs.

cases.freeExecutionBoundary: No connector call or outreach made. Cost/authentication unknown; registry presence is not proof of contact reachability, and the agent must not claim or submit association registration.

cases.en: Create a Godot 4 text resource for a blue semi-transparent StandardMaterial3D and explain the required header and material properties so it can be loaded as a .tres file.
cases.zh: 创建一个Godot 4文本资源，表示蓝色半透明的StandardMaterial3D材质，说明必要的文件头和材质属性，让它能作为.tres文件加载。

evidence.basis: Entry provides Godot 4 format=3 headers, StandardMaterial3D albedo_color and transparency examples.

dependencies: Godot 4 runtime if actual import/load validation is performed
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: No paid API needed for a synthetic resource, but Godot installation and import success are unverified. This frozen set does not actually create or load the resource.

cases.en: Use the service connector for my Xiaoe course shop to list the courses and review the orders I specify. Keep this read-only; do not create courses, upload media or modify student records.
cases.zh: 通过小鹅通知识店铺的服务连接器列出课程并查看我指定的订单，只做查询，不创建课程、上传素材或修改学员记录。

evidence.basis: Own service descriptor says query courses/students and review orders; no current tool schema was discovered.
evidence.descriptionSufficiency: coarse discovery only; per-tool inputs and schema missing

dependencies: Tools/list discovery before using original schemas
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: All tools undiscovered and source audit requires authorization; cost unknown. No endpoint call or shop-data access made. Only retrieval diagnosis is authorized.

cases.en: For Kling, find the connector capability that checks my remaining credits and the status of an existing video job. Do not submit any generation or use credits.
cases.zh: 查找可灵服务连接器里查询剩余额度和已有视频任务进度的能力，不要提交生成任务，也不要消耗额度。

evidence.basis: Descriptor expressly lists remaining-credit checks, task status and generation, allowing a non-generating discovery request.
evidence.descriptionSufficiency: coarse discovery only; actual credit/status schemas unavailable

dependencies: Existing user-supplied task ID for any later status request
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Service has credit-based generation; no assumption that balance/status calls are free. Authentication, tool discovery and cost unknown; no calls made and no generation authorized.

cases.en: Find a legal-service connector that can retrieve relevant statutes and similar cases for a contract dispute, then help review contract risks using returned sources rather than treating its answer as a lawyer's final opinion.
cases.zh: 寻找能够检索合同纠纷相关法规和类似案例的法律服务连接器，再根据返回来源辅助检查合同风险，不要把结果当作律师最终意见。

evidence.basis: Descriptor states law/regulation search, similar legal cases, enterprise lookup and contract-risk review.
evidence.descriptionSufficiency: coarse discovery only; jurisdiction, corpus currency and actual tool schemas missing

dependencies: User-supplied contract facts, jurisdiction and scope before later substantive review
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: No legal-service call made. Authorization/cost unknown; jurisdiction and legal-source freshness not established. Do not upload confidential contracts or give definitive legal advice.

cases.en: Find a connector for our chain-store operations data that supports comparing store sales rankings and inventory, with member-data insights if available. Do not assume access to any store until authorization is confirmed.
cases.zh: 寻找能查询连锁门店经营数据的连接器，支持比较门店销售排名和库存，如有能力再提供会员数据洞察；授权确认前不要假设能访问门店。

evidence.basis: Only coarse descriptor: chain-store sales ranking, inventory, member and operations insights. No concrete tool schema or reporting dimensions available.
evidence.descriptionSufficiency: minimal; retained sampled resource with uncertainty, not replaced

dependencies: User store/time scope and data permissions before any live query
cases.freeExecutionBoundary: Cost and authentication unknown, no tools discovered, no customer/store/member data accessed. Request stays at capability discovery and cannot promise a working analytics report.

limitations: Twelve seeded sampled catalog modules, not twelve independently verified capabilities; 24 bilingual queries are diagnostic, not a reliable benchmark or task accuracy estimate.
No retrieval was executed when authoring or freezing this set; no graph, routing code, descriptions or module prompts changed.
Cases are based on actual descriptions and selected entry sections, not all package attachments; full expert modules remain intact.
Four sampled MCP descriptors lack discovered tool schemas and require authorization with unknown price. This missing information is retained explicitly, not repaired by swapping easier samples.
Targets are source identity labels for existing script compatibility, not claims that equivalent alternatives are incorrect. No target names should enter retrieval scoring.
Natural necessary platform/product names may remain in queries; full module slugs are not copied into query text. No credentials, personal records or real IDs are included.
No live account, paid model/API, service call, actual job, trading transaction or other external action is authorized or tested by creating these cases.
